Ten functions and methods in `sklearn/` call `check_X_y` directly. I found them by searching for the name in all non-test files and taking the enclosing function for each call.

- **`sklearn/base.py`**: `BaseEstimator._validate_data` calls it at line 650.
- **`sklearn/metrics/cluster/_unsupervised.py`**: `silhouette_score` (line 134, only when `sample_size` is set), `silhouette_samples` (line 279), `calinski_harabasz_score` (line 368) and `davies_bouldin_score` (line 443). This file imports it through `sklearn.utils`, which re-exports it.
- **`sklearn/feature_selection/_univariate_selection.py`**: `f_classif` (line 171) and `r_regression` (line 363), also imported through `sklearn.utils`.
- **`sklearn/feature_selection/_mutual_info.py`**: `_estimate_mi` (line 271).
- **`sklearn/utils/_testing.py`**: `MinimalClassifier.fit` (line 955) and `MinimalRegressor.fit` (line 1004).

I left out the `_check_X_y` methods in `naive_bayes.py` and `utils/_mocking.py`. They are separate methods that happen to have a similar name, and none of them calls the validation function. No file imports it under a different name.
